home.name: John Gibson
home.news: The Red Wings scored only two goals combined in their first two games (0-2-0), but are coming off their first victory of the season. The 33-year-old Gibson saved 22 of 25 shots (.880 SV%) in the outing and received ample goal support, defeating the Ottawa Senators 5-3. Gibson has a 2.38 GAA and .903 SV% this season (1-2-0).

home.name: Logan Thompson
home.news: Thompson has quietly become one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies over the past several seasons, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. The 29-year-old goalie hopes to continue his upward trajectory after an encouraging start to the 2026-27 season, saving 58 of 63 shots (.921 SV%) through his first two games (2-0-0). The Capitals enter Friday's contest as -141 home favourites against a New York Rangers team that has outscored its opposition 16-5 during a four-game winning streak.

home.name: Cam Talbot
home.news: Talbot will make his Blue Jackets' debut vs. Pittsburgh on Thursday.
